question: 2 bags and 11 pens together cost ₹505, whereas 10 bags and 10 pens together cost ₹1310. The cost of 8 bags exceeds the cost of 8 pens by:
solution:
**Given:**

2 bags + 11 pens = ₹505 …(i)

10 bags + 10 pens = ₹1310 …(ii)

Formula used:

Linear equation subtraction method

**Calculations:**

Multiply (i) by 5: ⇒ 10 bags + 55 pens = ₹2525 …(iii)
